findings.title: Franchise managers see and export the previous outlet's cancellation records after switching outlets — report cache keys default to restaurant 0 and Switch Restaurant leaves the cache intact
findings.observed: Switching outlets within the cache TTL reuses the first outlet's cancellation rows

findings.title: Owners are falsely told all cancelled items are clean and no money leaked — the Audit tab hardcodes zero flags and leakage without checking any financial fields
findings.observed: Audit says All Clear and ₹0 leakage even when cancelled rows have unreverted amounts

findings.title: Managers lose legacy cancellation notes in both Cancellations exports — the new Note column exports cancelItemNote without the notes fallback used by the table
findings.observed: A visible legacy notes value exports as an empty Excel cell or — in the print report

findings.title: Managers cannot see cancellation rows or their notes beyond the first 200 in Item Cancellation Detail — the table slices the filtered rows without pagination
findings.observed: For 201 matching rows, Showing says 201 but only 200 rows can be viewed

findings.title: Managers downloading a filtered Cancellations report get other staff's and other scopes' rows too — the export uses cancelledItems instead of filteredTable
findings.observed: Selecting one staff or scope filters the table but Excel and PDF include all rows
